claim: Guideline volumetric LVEF is (EDV-ESV)/EDV and biplane disk summation is recommended when 3-D is unavailable.
project_decision: Use LVEF as a separate anchor; search and remove LVEDV/LVESV and EF aliases.
limitations: Does not establish which method generated project lvef labels.

claim: Linear or Teichholz-derived volumes can be inaccurate and are not interchangeable with biplane or 3-D volumetric LVEF.
project_decision: Fail closed on FS/LVEDD/LVESD as LVEF predictors until project method metadata are reviewed.
limitations: Does not make all linear dimensions deterministic LVEF proxies.

claim: RVSP is calculated from 4 times peak TR velocity squared plus estimated RAP; the RV-RA gradient is a separate component.
project_decision: Treat tr_mmhg/TRV as conditionally deterministic and fail closed pending raw definition and units.
limitations: Does not establish that project tr_mmhg is gradient rather than RVSP/PASP.

claim: Heart-failure guideline categories use LVEF <=40 for reduced EF, 41-49 for mildly reduced EF, and >=50 for preserved EF.
citation: ACC summary of 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Heart Failure Guideline.
project_decision: Keep lvef <40 as historical primary; add <=40 and <50 as secondary sensitivities only.
limitations: Guideline classification does not alter accepted-abstract endpoint fidelity and is not a model-error margin.

claim: FS equals (LVEDD-LVESD)/LVEDD times 100 under compatible phase plane and units.
citation: OpenEvidence cited measurement standards; cited full text was not supplied for this pass.
project_decision: Conditionally classify FS as formula-only after raw definition review.
limitations: Formula is standard but project fs definition method and units remain unverified.

claim: LVOT diameter and VTI can jointly derive stroke volume; adding heart rate and BSA can derive cardiac output and index.
citation: OpenEvidence formula synthesis; cited supporting full texts were not supplied for this pass.
project_decision: Search restricted registry for the derived outputs and mask complete formula sets if present.
limitations: The components do not reconstruct av_pk_vel or one another.

claim: Transmitral E/A and E/e-prime are ratios of separately acquired component velocities after unit harmonization.
citation: OpenEvidence cited ASE diastolic-function guidance; cited full text was not supplied for this pass.
project_decision: Search for ratio fields; do not call E/A/e-prime components duplicates.
limitations: Presence and definitions of project ratio fields are unknown.

claim: Septal thickness posterior-wall thickness and LVEDD can be inputs to a linear LV-mass formula.
citation: OpenEvidence cited ASE/EACVI sources; cited full text was not supplied for this pass.
project_decision: Retain dependency as conditional pending inf_lat_thickness definition and timing.
limitations: inf_lat_thickness cannot be assumed to be posterior wall from its name.

claim: Height alone cannot determine BSA; standard BSA equations also require weight and a chosen equation.
citation: OpenEvidence cited Haycock and Verbraecken; full texts were not supplied for this pass.
project_decision: Keep BSA and height as context-only targets and inspect weight/formula metadata.
limitations: No project BSA formula or weight field has been established.

claim: Aortic sinus ascending-aorta and arch diameters are distinct anatomic-level concepts and edge/timing conventions affect comparability.
citation: OpenEvidence cited the 2022 ACC/AHA aortic disease guideline; full text was not supplied for this pass.
project_decision: Keep as separate provisional targets pending raw level edge timing and unit review.
limitations: Do not infer duplicate or distinct export status from canonical names alone.

claim: The locally supplied ICU TTE study reported median VTI least significant change of 11% for repeated exams by one operator and 14% when operators differed.
source_locator: Supplied PDF: Jozwiak et al. 2019, Crit Care — PMID 30971307. VTI measurement precision:LSC.pdf; SHA-256 d99efb85a46f5f436febbb9d725002121c647b171698301b9d56dfd5e1f50cfb
project_decision: Record as relative repeatability context only; do not convert it into a native-unit model margin.
limitations: ICU TTE change precision is population method rhythm and operator dependent and is not a report-label MAE equivalence study.

claim: A 5-EF-point tolerance 4/8-point sensitivities 1-point paired-MAE tie margin with 0.5/2 sensitivities and 35-45 band with 37-43 sensitivity are candidate analysis values.
citation: Phase 1C owner specification informed by but not equivalent to reader-variability literature.
project_decision: Prespecify with EXPERT_INFERENCE labels; never call guideline equivalence MCID or clinical truth.
limitations: The OpenEvidence reproducibility citations supporting numerical context were not supplied in full and portions of its ruling were malformed.

claim: mv_peak_e and mitral_e_velocity may be duplicate transmitral E exports.
project_decision: Exclude both from each other's predictor sets and do not merge until CMR-02 resolves identity.
limitations: No citation can determine a project-specific export mapping.

claim: tr_mmhg may denote peak TR gradient RVSP/PASP or another pressure construct.
project_decision: Do not score or formula-classify until CMR-01 resolves it.
limitations: Clinical formulas cannot determine the semantics of this project field.

claim: The exact historical primary binary endpoint is lvef <40.
citation: Accepted ASA abstract version 10 preserved verbatim in the repository.
project_decision: Preserve the strict inequality and count labels equal to 40 before test-performance access.
limitations: This is protocol fidelity rather than a claim that <40 is the guideline inequality.
